_meta.purpose: CL-PHYS-03 §4 evaluation-layer venue opening hours. The evaluation layer injects a REQUIRED `venue_hours_policy` gate for every opportunity_id present here: an hour bucket whose LOCAL start is outside [open, close) can never become a 推薦. The pinned canonical opportunity records under data/v2/opportunities/ are never edited for this.
policy: A venue absent from this table is UNKNOWN, never assumed open: the gate is simply not injected (abstain). Hours are never invented to make a gate fire.
Every entry must carry source_kind + source + retrieved_at so the table can be audited.

Hours are the venue's LOCAL civil clock; [open, close) is half-open and the judged instant is the hour bucket START. Overnight windows (close <= open) are treated as malformed and abstain (UNKNOWN), never guessed.
confirmed_by is the owner ticket that asserted the window; a table row without confirmed_by is not authoritative.
provenance_rules: Hours must name the page they were read from (URL + retrieved_at). 'Well-known' opening hours are not a source and must not be entered here.

The evaluation gate judges the hour on the PLACE's local clock, derived from the place coordinate's UTC offset. The `timezone` field on an entry is NOT read by the gate: it is kept for future use and labelled timezone_unused=true so the next reader does not trust it as the gate's clock.

jp-018-P01.timezone_note: UNUSED by the evaluation gate: EVALGATE-venue-hours judges the LOCAL HOUR START from the place coordinate's UTC offset, not from this field. Kept for future use only; do not read it as the gate's clock.
jp-018-P01.source: Verified against nagoya-info.jp (名古屋市公式観光情報, https://www.nagoya-info.jp/spot/detail/1/, retrieved 2026-11-26): 営業時間 9:00～16:30（本丸御殿への入場は16:00まで）, 休館日 12/29～1/1. Secondary cross-ref: Nagoya Castle official site (nagoyajo.city.nagoya.jp) carries the same 9:00-16:30 window.
